subject: Intermittent session resets & p95 elevation — EU hosted API (update)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: GreenThread AI <ops@greenthread.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 18 Mar 2028 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Intermittent session resets & p95 elevation — EU hosted API (update)

Hi Arjun,

I wanted to surface an incident we observed starting ~13:40 UTC that impacted session stability and p95 response times for a subset of EU-hosted inference requests. You may have seen some truncated responses or session resets for short-running chat workloads.

What happened (brief):
- Root cause appears to be a bug in our connection reaper that triggered premature KV-cache eviction during specific prefix patterns.
- This led to increased initialization work on retries and elevated p95s for requests with session affinity.

What we did quickly:
- At 13:52 UTC we pushed a targeted config change to disable the reaper for affected pools.
- At 14:05 UTC we reverted an unrelated cache-pressure heuristic that made the pattern worse.

Current status:
- Traffic has stabilized for most workloads, p95s are trending back toward normal but we are still monitoring.
- We have opened a follow-up post-incident review and will publish a detailed timeline.

Immediate ask: can you confirm if you continue to see session resets on your side (sample request IDs are helpful)? We also attached a short incident timeline and the mitigation runbook we executed.

Apologies for the disruption — I'll follow up with a formal postmortem and action items once we've completed the investigation.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — we saw this on our side too.

Symptoms we observed:
- Several user sessions got disconnected during form-fill flows, roughly 13:45–14:00 UTC.
- Re-running the same payloads immediately sometimes succeeded (we suspect retry behavior hid the issue).

Sample IDs: rt_gh_00123, rt_gh_00124 — both failed once then succeeded on retry.

We appreciate the quick mitigation. Please keep us posted if there are any configuration changes we should make client-side to avoid retries amplifying the problem.

Arjun

Subject: Follow-up: Incident summary and next steps — EU hosted API session stability

Hi Arjun,

Thanks for confirming and for the sample request IDs — that helped us validate the retry signature. Below is a short customer-facing summary of what happened and what we'll do next. We'll also post this to the status page and link the more detailed postmortem when ready.

Incident summary:
- Timeline: 13:40 UTC — 14:05 UTC (mitigations applied; traffic stabilized).
- Impact: Intermittent session resets and elevated p95s for a subset of EU-hosted API requests. Some retries observed client-side.
- Root cause (preliminary): A recent change to the connection reaper incorrectly matched prefix patterns, triggering premature KV-cache eviction and extra initialization work on subsequent requests.

Actions taken:
- Disabled the offending reaper rule and reverted a cache-pressure heuristic (13:52–14:05 UTC).
- Monitored affected pools; p95s returned to expected ranges by 14:15 UTC.
- Opened a formal post-incident review and will deliver an action list and timeline.

Planned next steps (what you can expect):
1) Detailed postmortem published to the drive link above by EOD tomorrow with timeline, root cause, and engineering action items.
2) A code-level fix and automated test to prevent similar reaper regressions within 2 weeks.
3) We will provide a small credit against your April usage invoice for the interruption — we'll route details through your finance contact unless you prefer otherwise.

If you saw any other request IDs or specific user-facing examples, please reply with them and we'll include them in the investigation.

Apologies again for the interruption and thank you for the quick signal.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
